song.title: He is my everything
song.lyrics:
[V1] . E B He is my everything, He is my all . F#m B E B7 He is my everything both great and small . E E7 He gave His life for me, . A Am made everything new . E B He is my everything, now, . E E7 how about you?
[C1] . A Like honey in the rock, . E sweet honey in the rock . B B7 For He tastes like honey in the rock . E E7 A Oh taste and see, that the Lord is good . E B7 E For He tastes like honey in the rock
[V2] . E B Some folks may ask me, some folks may say . F#m B E B7 Who is this Jesus, you talk about everyday . E E7 A Am He is my Saviour, and He sets me free . E Now Listen, what I'll tell you . B E A/E what He means to me.
